name: Nowadays
long_description:
Nowadays is the AI-native platform for corporate meetings and events. Our AI doesn't just assist planners, it does the work: it emails and calls venues, negotiates rates in 22 languages, and parses 50-page hotel proposals into clean apples-to-apples comparisons. Clients routinely save 20-30% vs. booking direct, and one Fortune 500 VP uncovered $18M in unmanaged meeting spend just by turning Nowadays on.

We started out working with small startups. Today, Google, Airbnb, BlackRock, Anthropic, Pylon, and Mintlify use Nowadays to bring their people together, from one epic kickoff a year to thousands of meetings annually.
one_liner: AI-native platform for corporate meetings and events
